name: Reappearance of a Stopped Clock
source:
An Irish tech CEO disappears along with his company's time machine. Three hours later, he's found dead on the opposite side of the world.
Two witnesses to the disappearance start to piece together what really happened.

[From [url=https://lyozoan.itch.io/stopped-clock]itch.io[/url]]
